title: BOAT: Beta Blocker Uptitration With OptiVol After Cardiac Resynchronization Therapy (CRT)
brief_summary: Many heart failure patients are unable to reach target beta blocker doses. This study will address whether cardiac resynchronization therapy (CRT) will enable uptitration of beta-blockers to target doses and whether it will favorably affect remodeling by reducing left ventricular end systolic volume (LVESV), with measurable clinical benefit, beyond CRT alone (without changes in beta-blocker dose).
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* NYHA III-IV
* QRS \> 120 msec
* On medical therapy, but beta blocker dose not @ target (carvedilol 25 bid, metoprolol succinate 200 qd)

Exclusion Criteria:

* QRS \< 120 msec
* On target beta blocker dose
